purpose: Quantify how transparent, mean-preserving service-time variability assumptions change delay, queueing, and clearance outcomes while the Base arrival input, service means, capacity, routing, and queue policy remain fixed.
post_outcome_disclosure: This study was designed after the registered capacity studies. It tests robustness to unmeasured service-time variability and does not modify, replace, or retroactively reinterpret the frozen 300-second confirmatory, capacity-availability, or response-surface results.

service_cv_grid.selection_rationale: The three levels distinguish deterministic service, moderate positive variability, and high positive variability without claiming that either positive CV was measured at an HTX site. The full factorial separates stage-specific effects from joint interaction.

distribution_contract.stage_stream_rule: Security and Immigration use separate java.util.Random instances deterministically derived from the registered service_seed. The AnyLogic default generator remains arrival-only.
distribution_contract.fixed_arm_rule: CV zero has no service shock. It shares arrival, routing, and tie streams with positive-CV arms, but no service-shock alignment is claimed for a deterministic service demand.

seed_policy.reuse_rule: For replication r, all nine CV cells copy the exact Base master, arrival, service, routing, and tie seed tuple from the registered confirmatory manifest.
seed_policy.paired_interpretation_gate: Paired intervals may be reported only after exact coverage and seed checks, traveller-level arrival/routing/tie alignment, and positive-CV implied-latent alignment all pass.

analysis.uncertainty: Report replication-level means with 95% Student-t intervals. Use paired differences only after the registered CRN alignment gate passes.
analysis.multiplicity_rule: No confirmatory p-value, calibrated distribution claim, or staffing decision claim. Treat all stage rankings, curvature, interactions, and tail diagnostics as descriptive exploratory findings.

cross_batch_reference.restriction: The old run is not pooled into the new estimates and is never overwritten.

calibration_boundary.interpretation: Results describe sensitivity of the existing assumption sandbox to declared service-time shape choices. They do not identify the service distribution of an HTX checkpoint.
